Name: Eliakim, Son of Hilkiah
Summary: Eliakim, son of Hilkiah, was over Hezekiah's household and answered Sennacherib's Rabshakeh at the wall, then reported his words to the king with torn clothes.
KeyStory: Eliakim answers the Rabshakeh and reports to Hezekiah.
RelatedPeople: King Hezekiah; Shebna, Scribe; Joah, Son of Asaph; Sennacherib, King of Assyria
LifeLesson: A steward's steady answer at the wall gave his king room to pray.
